links.outcome: Precision and F1 of reconstructed NarxCare models versus reported benchmarks on claims data
links.effect: Precision 0.01-0.32 versus reported benchmark 0.75; F1 0.02-0.39 versus benchmark 0.65, across all reconstructed models, even with socioeconomic covariates added.
links.quote: Despite adding socioeconomic covariates, precision (0.01-0.32) was far below the reported benchmark of 0.75, and F1 scores (0.02-0.39) were also substantially lower than the benchmark value of 0.65, across all our reconstructed models.

unlisted_practices: Independent reconstruction of proprietary algorithm from technical specifications to audit reported performance
Transparency regulation for proprietary clinical risk scores

screen.reason: Empirical replication and validation study investigating the performance and opacity/discrepancies of the widely used proprietary NarxCare risk scoring tool on external claims data.
